whyNoModelVerdicts: every verdict must carry PRODUCT_OWNER attribution. No agent may supply one, no default supplies one, and no code path in the builder writes one. The deterministic scoring is evidence in the packet and is never shown as a suggested answer.
ambiguityRule: AMBIGUOUS is never a pass. On a hard-gate slot it makes the gate UNDETERMINED, which blocks acceptance exactly as FAILED does.
notExercisedRule: permitted only where the design targeted an axis and the opportunity did not materialise, with a recorded reason. A vacuous CORRECT is forbidden. A NOT_EXERCISED on a hard-gate slot reduces that gate denominator; below the preregistered minimum the gate is COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT, which is not a pass.
